description: The emails every report the user can see sent, of any type, newest first, each with its report, as the app's Email sends page lists them: pass status failed and since to find the ones that didn't go out, and burstId for one burst's. Same fields as listReportEmails. Answers up to limit emails, 20 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

burstId.description: Only the emails of this burst, by its `id` from `listBursts`: each variant's own emails, and the emails its email configurations sent, which list its template as their report. If omitted, every report's.

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `20`.

since.description: Only what happened at or after this time, as an ISO 8601 date and time in UTC, such as `2026-11-08T18:00:00Z`. If omitted, from the start.

status.description: Only the emails in this state, as the Email sends page filters them: `failed` the ones that could not be sent, `opened` the ones a recipient opened, and `delivered` the ones the email server accepted, opened or not. If omitted, every email.

name: listEmails
title: List sent emails of all reports
